Question: Q1. Which category generates the most revenue?
Answer (from data): Electronics: ₹3.01 Cr (50.1% of revenue). Next: Fashion (20.1%).

Question: Q2. Which category generates the most profit?
Answer (from data): Fashion: ₹51.58 L (36.8% of profit) at a 42.8% margin, although it is only 20.1% of revenue.

Question: Q3. Which products generate the most revenue?
Answer (from data): Nova X7 Pro Smartphone 256GB ₹57.38 L; Nova X5 Smartphone 128GB ₹52.65 L; AeroBook 14 Laptop ₹34.15 L. All three are Electronics.

Question: Q7. What is the monthly revenue trend?
Answer (from data): Upward with slowing growth: 2023 ₹1.31 Cr -> 2024 ₹1.98 Cr (+51.4%) -> 2025 ₹2.72 Cr (+37.7%). Month-to-month swings are large (MoM growth ranges -29.2% to +89.4%).

Question: Q8. Is there evidence of seasonality?
Answer (from data): Yes, for Q4. The peak month was Oct in all 3 years, and Oct, Nov, Dec were above the year's average month in every year (October averages 1.59x an average month; after removing trend, 1.51x). October also has the lowest margin (15.3%-16.9%).

Question: Q9. How concentrated is revenue among customers?
Answer (from data): Top 1% of customers -> 9.0%, top 5% -> 30.0%, top 10% -> 45.5%, top 20% -> 64.3% of revenue. Gini = 0.61.

Question: Q10. What is the relationship between discount and profitability?
Answer (from data): Negative. Line-level Spearman rho(discount, margin) = -0.32; within categories it ranges -0.89 to -0.37. E.g. Fashion margin falls from 52.2% at 0% to 25.0% at 35-40%. Quantity barely moves (rho 0.06). Association, not causation.

Question: Q11. Which areas have high revenue but comparatively low profit?
Answer (from data): Electronics: 50.1% of revenue but 23.3% of profit (margin 10.9%). Lowest-margin sub-categories: Televisions -1.7%, Laptops 4.9%, Smartphones 6.1%. Televisions lost money overall.

Question: Q12. Which customer characteristics appear associated with higher revenue?
Answer (from data): Behaviour far more than demographics. Significant (p<0.05): Age_Band 35-49 (₹22,012); Customer_Age Spearman rho = 0.228; Total_Orders Spearman rho = 0.842; Average_Order_Value Spearman rho = 0.808; Categories_Bought Spearman rho = 0.772; Average_Discount Spearman rho = -0.304; Return_Rate Spearman rho = 0.182. Not significant: Gender, Region, Preferred_Payment.
